Åbo Akademi University's research data guidance says researchers are responsible for their own work, should check all AI-produced results, and should be transparent about AI-tool use.

Åbo Akademi University's research data guidance says personal data and confidential information must never be entered into an open AI tool, and that data protection must be considered when using closed tools.
Åbo Akademi University's Open University teacher guidance says teachers cannot require students to use AI to complete an assignment because AI requires registration on an external service.

Åbo Akademi University's Open University teacher guidance says students in courses should be informed about the principles and disadvantages of AI or language-model use, and teachers should make clear what applies in each specific course.
